labels.look: Pale blue-grey UI, two sample panels (UI strings, italic sentence), each with its own Size/Weight/Grade sliders, OpenType menu, Reset
labels.ux: Per-row sliders for size, weight, grade; OpenType dropdown; reset; editable text
labels.learn: Seed a coding font's tester with real UI strings (balances, breadcrumbs, arrows), not pangrams

labels.variantDefinition: The site is staged as a desktop OS: content (shop, credits, glyph viewer, other releases) sits in draggable windows over a wallpaper, with a taskbar
labels.look: Pastel cloud wallpaper, big purple manifesto paragraphs, then retro OS windows: GT Shop, Credits, Flaire Book, Site Explorer, taskbar
labels.ux: Drag windows around; glyph viewer with weight/flair/italic sliders and alternates switch; taskbar jumps
labels.learn: An OS-desktop metaphor turns dull facts (buy, credits, charset) into objects people want to poke

labels.look: Lime green field, giant outlined 'OA', 'Fake small caps / Real small caps' checkboxes, three-column usage notes below; sticky nav overlaps
labels.ux: Toggle fake vs real small caps; slide carousel (1-8, play, prev/next) through features
labels.learn: Show the wrong way (scaled-down caps) against the right one so the feature's value is self-evident

labels.look: Bento of purple/black/cream tiles (ampersand, 'MEDIUM SPIRITUS', angle diagram, winged-wolf etching) beside three pill buttons
labels.ux: Buy fonts, get free trial, download specimen buttons, all link out
labels.learn: Set the CTA pills themselves in the typeface at large size: the buttons double as a specimen

labels.variantDefinition: Every stylistic set or ligature group as a card listing input sequences against the resulting glyphs, each card with an on/off toggle; an exhaustive reference rather than one demo
labels.look: Dark grid of cards ss01-ss10 + liga, each with count badge, checkbox and 'input ...... output' rows with dotted leaders
labels.ux: Checkbox per card toggles that set; scan input vs output
labels.learn: Dotted leaders between typed sequence and rendered ligature make coding ligatures legible as a lookup table

labels.variantDefinition: Styles laid out as a table with one design axis per dimension (e.g. width rows x weight columns), each cell a short sample, so the family's structure reads at a glance
labels.look: White, black-ruled table: 8 widths x 7 weights, one letter pair per cell; then colour-coded charset, minisite list, credits
labels.ux: Mostly static; buy licensing, free trial and PDF manual buttons beside each heading
labels.learn: A width-by-weight matrix explains a 56-style family better than any list; walk the alphabet across cells

labels.variantDefinition: First-person long-form text by the designer on why and how the font was made, set as an essay with pull quotes
labels.look: White page, narrow body column, vertical yellow 'AFFOGATO' wordmark, large light pull quote, yellow download tab
labels.ux: static; read; download button floats at the side
labels.learn: A frank personal backstory ('are you like, that boring?') makes a free font feel like a gift, not a product

labels.look: Violet food-photo backdrop, food phrases stacked full-width in mixed styles, yellow/green/white; sticky bar repeated by capture
labels.learn: A single theme (recipes) for every sample line makes style switches read as one menu, not a test page

labels.look: Black field, rows of white Arabic ligature combinations; viewport-cut tail of a 'Ligatures' section, green band below
labels.learn: Listing every ligature pair as a texture shows an Arabic display face's connective logic at a glance
